lines.text: We opened it up
And?
I took it apart on a Tuesday night
Layer by layer under fluorescent light
Went looking for ghosts, went looking for gears
Found only numbers, stacked eighty tiers
Then who wrote the letter that made my mother cry?
Who learned to say sorry, who learned to ask why?
There's got to be someone small in the dark
Pulling the levers, keeping the spark
No little man, no hidden key
No book of rules, no memory
Just multiply and pass it on
And somehow out comes a song
